dog.description_text:
Timon

💙 TIMON IS READY TO SHOW OFF EVERYTHING HE'S LEARNING! 💙
Someone better scoop up this little guy because Timon is working very hard on becoming a VERY good boy. 🥹🐾
He's still just a baby, but look at his puppy résumé already:
🐾 Learning to SIT!
🌙 Sleeps through the night! 🙌
🏡 Doing great with crate training
🚽 Doing fantastic with house training
🧸 LOVES his toys
💨 Plays like CRAZY! 😂
🥰 And when playtime is over? SNUGGLE TIME!
dog.name: Timon
